---
title: "SEC Insider Filings (Forms 3, 4, 5) Collection Pipeline"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
params:
  user_agent: "Thomas Benacci tabenacci@gmail.com"       # user credentials for accessing SEC data
  data_dir: "insider_data"                               # folder for storing SEC-reported insider data
  start_date: "2006-01-01"                               # earliest recorded date in quarterly-compiled files
  form_types: ["3", "3/A", "4", "4/A", "5", "5/A"]       # form types (3: Initial Statement of Beneficial Ownership, 4: Changes in Beneficial Ownership, 5: Annual Statement of Changes in Beneficial Ownership, where "A" stand for Ammendment documents)
  include_today: true                                    # collect forms on today's system date
  requests_per_second: 8                                 # under 10 to prevent rate limit error
  max_parse_attempts: 3                                  # maximum number of attempts to request a filing before moving on
  chunk_size: 2000                                       # batch size of filings to collect before saving them
  keep_zips: false                                       # 
  sec_base: "https://www.sec.gov"                        #
  as_of: ""                                              # 
---

<!--
HOW TO RUN
  1. Set user_agent above to your name and email (the SEC requires it).
  2. Knit in RStudio, or from a terminal / scheduler:
       Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("01_insider_pipeline.Rmd")'
  3. Run it as often as you like. Every run brings the data fully up to date and
     only does the work that is still missing.

REQUIRED PACKAGES: data.table, curl, xml2, R.utils, rmarkdown

WHAT IT DOES
  Step 1  Downloads the SEC's quarterly Insider Transactions Data Sets (bulk,
          fast) and re-ingests any quarter the SEC has re-published.
  Step 2  Downloads EDGAR's own filing index (the authoritative list of every
          filing) for every quarter, plus the daily indexes for the last
          10 days and, when run on the current day, today's live filings.
  Step 3  Compares the two by accession number and downloads and parses only
          the filings that are not already stored, directly from EDGAR.
  Step 4  Writes a completeness report that accounts for every filing in
          EDGAR's index: stored, or listed with the reason it could not be.

OUTPUT (in data_dir/tables/, one folder per table, one .csv.gz per quarter)
  The eight tables and their columns follow the SEC's documentation exactly:
  https://www.sec.gov/files/insider_transactions_readme.pdf
  Files named sec_YYYYqN come from the SEC's quarterly data sets, and files named
  xml_YYYYqN were parsed from the original filings. When the SEC later publishes
  a quarter, its version replaces the parsed one automatically. Use
  read_insider.R to load the tables.
-->

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(curl)
  library(xml2)
})
if (!requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE))
  stop("Package 'R.utils' is required to read .csv.gz files: install.packages('R.utils')")
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "C"))   # SEC dates use English month abbreviations
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || !length(a)) b else a
say <- function(...) cat(paste0(...), "\n", sep = "")
show <- function(x, caption = NULL, ...) {          # plain console-style table
  if (!is.null(caption)) cat(caption, "\n", sep = "")
  print(as.data.table(x), nrows = 1e5, row.names = FALSE)
  cat("\n")
}
fmt_min <- function(t0) { m <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "mins"))
  if (m < 1) sprintf("%.0f sec", m * 60) else if (m < 120) sprintf("%.1f min", m) else sprintf("%.1f hours", m / 60) }
```

```{r config}
P     <- params
UA    <- P$user_agent
BASE  <- sub("/+$", "", P$sec_base)
DATA  <- P$data_dir
START <- as.Date(P$start_date)
FORMS <- as.character(unlist(P$form_types))
RATE  <- as.numeric(P$requests_per_second)
MAXPF <- as.integer(P$max_parse_attempts)
CHUNK <- as.integer(P$chunk_size)
AS_OF <- if (is.null(P$as_of) || !nzchar(P$as_of)) Sys.Date() else as.Date(P$as_of)
LIVE  <- isTRUE(P$include_today) && AS_OF == Sys.Date()

stopifnot(!is.na(START), !is.na(AS_OF), START <= AS_OF, RATE > 0, RATE <= 10,
          MAXPF >= 1, CHUNK >= 1, all(FORMS %in% c("3", "3/A", "4", "4/A", "5", "5/A")))
if (BASE == "https://www.sec.gov" && grepl("example\\.com|Your Name", UA))
  stop("Set the user_agent parameter to your name and email address. ",
       "The SEC blocks automated requests that don't identify the requester.")

D <- list(tables   = file.path(DATA, "tables"),
          state    = file.path(DATA, "state"),
          registry = file.path(DATA, "state", "registry"),
          index    = file.path(DATA, "state", "index"),
          zips     = file.path(DATA, "state", "zips"))
invisible(lapply(D, dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))

LOG_FILE <- file.path(D$state, "run_log.txt")
log_msg <- function(...) {
  line <- sprintf("[%s] %s", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), paste0(...))
  cat(line, "\n", sep = "", file = stderr())
  cat(line, "\n", sep = "", file = LOG_FILE, append = TRUE)
}

# One run at a time: a second concurrent run could corrupt the files.
LOCK <- file.path(D$state, "run.lock")
if (file.exists(LOCK)) {
  info  <- readLines(LOCK, warn = FALSE)
  pid   <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(info[1]))
  age_h <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), file.mtime(LOCK), units = "hours"))
  alive <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "unix" && !is.na(pid)) isTRUE(tools::pskill(pid, 0L)) else age_h < 24
  if (alive && age_h < 48)
    stop("Another run appears to be in progress (", LOCK, "). If it is not, delete that file and run again.")
}
writeLines(c(as.character(Sys.getpid()), format(Sys.time())), LOCK)
.lock_guard <- new.env()
invisible(reg.finalizer(.lock_guard, function(e) unlink(LOCK), onexit = TRUE))

RUN_START <- Sys.time()
log_msg("==== Run started | as of ", AS_OF, " | start ", START, " | forms ", paste(FORMS, collapse = ","))
```

```{r http}
# ---- HTTP: rate-limited to RATE requests per second across everything ----
HTTP <- new.env()
HTTP$next_ok <- 0

throttle <- function(k = 1) {
  now <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  if (HTTP$next_ok > now) Sys.sleep(HTTP$next_ok - now)
  HTTP$next_ok <- max(as.numeric(Sys.time()), HTTP$next_ok) + 1.05 * k / RATE   # 5% safety margin
}
pause_for <- function(sec) HTTP$next_ok <- max(HTTP$next_ok, as.numeric(Sys.time()) + sec)
handle <- function(...) new_handle(useragent = UA, connecttimeout = 30, ...)

# Single request into memory. Returns list(status, raw, headers). Status 0 = network error.
sec_fetch <- function(url, tries = 5, nobody = FALSE) {
  st <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {
    throttle(1)
    res <- tryCatch(curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = handle(timeout = 120, nobody = nobody)),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    st <- if (is.null(res)) 0L else as.integer(res$status_code)
    if (st == 403L && !is_rate_limit(res$content)) st <- 404L
    if (st %in% c(200L, 404L))
      return(list(status = st, raw = if (st == 200L) res$content else NULL, headers = res$headers))
    if (i < tries) {
      wait <- if (st %in% c(403L, 429L)) 60 * i else 2^i
      log_msg("HTTP ", st, " for ", url, "; retrying in ", wait, "s")
      pause_for(wait)
    }
  }
  list(status = st, raw = NULL, headers = NULL)
}

# Single request straight to disk (large files). Returns the HTTP status.
sec_fetch_disk <- function(url, dest, tries = 4) {
  tmp <- paste0(dest, ".part")
  st <- 0L
  for (i in seq_len(tries)) {
    throttle(1)
    res <- tryCatch(curl_fetch_disk(url, tmp, handle = handle(timeout = 3600)), error = function(e) NULL)
    st <- if (is.null(res)) 0L else as.integer(res$status_code)
    if (st == 200L) { replace_file(tmp, dest); return(st) }
    if (st == 403L && file.exists(tmp) && !is_rate_limit(readBin(tmp, "raw", 20000))) st <- 404L
    unlink(tmp)
    if (st == 404L) return(st)
    if (i < tries) {
      wait <- if (st %in% c(403L, 429L)) 60 * i else 2^i
      log_msg("HTTP ", st, " for ", url, "; retrying in ", wait, "s")
      pause_for(wait)
    }
  }
  st
}

# Many small requests, RATE at a time in parallel, never more than RATE per second.
fetch_many <- function(urls) {
  n <- length(urls)
  out <- vector("list", n)
  if (!n) return(out)
  for (b in split(seq_len(n), ceiling(seq_len(n) / RATE))) {
    throttle(length(b))
    pool <- new_pool(total_con = length(b), host_con = length(b))
    for (k in b) local({
      j <- k
      curl_fetch_multi(
        urls[j], pool = pool, handle = handle(timeout = 90),
        done = function(res) {
          st <- as.integer(res$status_code)
          if (st == 403L && !is_rate_limit(res$content)) st <- 404L
          out[[j]] <<- list(status = st, raw = if (st == 200L) res$content else NULL)
        },
        fail = function(msg) out[[j]] <<- list(status = 0L, raw = NULL))
    })
    multi_run(pool = pool)
    st <- vapply(out[b], function(x) if (is.null(x)) 0L else x$status, integer(1))
    if (any(st %in% c(403L, 429L))) {
      log_msg("SEC rate limit response (HTTP ", st[st %in% c(403L, 429L)][1], "); pausing 60s")
      pause_for(60)
    }
  }
  lapply(out, function(x) x %||% list(status = 0L, raw = NULL))
}

replace_file <- function(tmp, dest) {
  if (!file.rename(tmp, dest)) {
    unlink(dest)
    if (!file.rename(tmp, dest)) stop("Could not write ", dest)
  }
}
raw_text <- function(raw) { raw[raw == as.raw(0)] <- as.raw(32); rawToChar(raw) }
# EDGAR answers 403 both for real rate limiting and for files that don't exist (yet).
# Only the rate-limit page mentions the request rate / automated tools; any other 403 means "not there".
is_rate_limit <- function(raw) {
  if (is.null(raw) || !length(raw)) return(FALSE)
  grepl("rate threshold|request rate|automated tool", raw_text(raw[seq_len(min(length(raw), 20000))]),
        ignore.case = TRUE)
}
```

```{r schema}
# ---- Schema: the SEC's eight tables, columns exactly as documented ----
fn <- function(...) { x <- c(...); as.vector(rbind(x, paste0(x, "_FN"))) }

SCHEMA <- list(
  SUBMISSION = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "FILING_DATE", "PERIOD_OF_REPORT", "DATE_OF_ORIG_SUB",
                 "NO_SECURITIES_OWNED", "NOT_SUBJECT_SEC16", "FORM3_HOLDING_REPORTED",
                 "FORM4_TRANS_REPORTED", "DOCUMENT_TYPE", "ISSUERCIK", "ISSUERNAME",
                 "ISSUERTRADINGSYMBOL", "REMARKS", "AFF10B5ONE", "SOURCE"),
  REPORTINGOWNER = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "RPTOWNERCIK", "RPTOWNERNAME", "RPTOWNER_RELATIONSHIP",
                     "RPTOWNER_TITLE", "RPTOWNER_TXT", "RPTOWNER_STREET1", "RPTOWNER_STREET2",
                     "RPTOWNER_CITY", "RPTOWNER_STATE", "RPTOWNER_ZIPCODE", "RPTOWNER_STATE_DESC",
                     "FILE_NUMBER", "IS_DIRECTOR", "IS_OFFICER", "IS_TENPERCENTOWNER", "IS_OTHER"),
  NONDERIV_TRANS = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "NONDERIV_TRANS_SK", fn("SECURITY_TITLE", "TRANS_DATE",
                     "DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE"), "TRANS_FORM_TYPE", "TRANS_CODE", "EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED",
                     "EQUITY_SWAP_TRANS_CD_FN", fn("TRANS_TIMELINESS", "TRANS_SHARES",
                     "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS",
                     "VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP")),
  NONDERIV_HOLDING = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "NONDERIV_HOLDING_SK", fn("SECURITY_TITLE",
                       "TRANS_FORM_TYPE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS",
                       "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP")),
  DERIV_TRANS = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "DERIV_TRANS_SK", fn("SECURITY_TITLE", "CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE",
                  "TRANS_DATE", "DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE"), "TRANS_FORM_TYPE", "TRANS_CODE",
                  "EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED", "EQUITY_SWAP_TRANS_CD_FN", fn("TRANS_TIMELINESS",
                  "TRANS_SHARES", "TRANS_TOTAL_VALUE", "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD",
                  "EXCERCISE_DATE", "EXPIRATION_DATE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_TITLE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES",
                  "UNDLYNG_SEC_VALUE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS",
                  "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP")),
  DERIV_HOLDING = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "DERIV_HOLDING_SK", fn("SECURITY_TITLE", "CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE",
                    "TRANS_FORM_TYPE", "EXERCISE_DATE", "EXPIRATION_DATE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_TITLE",
                    "UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES", "UNDLYNG_SEC_VALUE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS",
                    "VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP")),
  FOOTNOTES = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "FOOTNOTE_ID", "FOOTNOTE_TXT"),
  OWNER_SIGNATURE = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "OWNERSIGNATURENAME", "OWNERSIGNATUREDATE")
)
TABLES      <- names(SCHEMA)
WRITE_ORDER <- c(setdiff(TABLES, "SUBMISSION"), "SUBMISSION")   # SUBMISSION last = batch complete
ADDED_COLS  <- c("SOURCE", "IS_DIRECTOR", "IS_OFFICER", "IS_TENPERCENTOWNER", "IS_OTHER")
REQUIRED    <- list(SUBMISSION = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "FILING_DATE", "DOCUMENT_TYPE", "ISSUERCIK"),
                    REPORTINGOWNER = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "RPTOWNERCIK"),
                    NONDERIV_TRANS = c("ACCESSION_NUMBER", "TRANS_CODE", "TRANS_SHARES", "TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD"))
ACC_RE <- "^\\d{10}-\\d{2}-\\d{6}$"

DATE_COLS <- c("FILING_DATE", "PERIOD_OF_REPORT", "DATE_OF_ORIG_SUB", "TRANS_DATE", "DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE",
               "EXCERCISE_DATE", "EXERCISE_DATE", "EXPIRATION_DATE", "OWNERSIGNATUREDATE")
NUM_COLS  <- c("TRANS_SHARES", "TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS",
               "CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE", "TRANS_TOTAL_VALUE", "UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES", "UNDLYNG_SEC_VALUE")
BOOL_COLS <- c("NO_SECURITIES_OWNED", "NOT_SUBJECT_SEC16", "FORM3_HOLDING_REPORTED", "FORM4_TRANS_REPORTED",
               "AFF10B5ONE", "EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED", "IS_DIRECTOR", "IS_OFFICER", "IS_TENPERCENTOWNER", "IS_OTHER")
CIK_COLS  <- c("ISSUERCIK", "RPTOWNERCIK")

# ---- Value standardization (identical output for both sources) ----
to_iso <- function(x) {                     # ISO, DD-MON-YYYY or YYYYMMDD -> "YYYY-MM-DD"
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  u <- unique(x[!is.na(x) & nzchar(x)])
  if (!length(u)) return(rep(NA_character_, length(x)))
  d <- as.Date(substr(u, 1, 10), "%Y-%m-%d")
  for (f in c("%d-%b-%Y", "%Y%m%d")) {
    i <- is.na(d)
    if (any(i)) d[i] <- as.Date(u[i], f)
  }
  as.character(d)[match(x, u)]
}
to_num  <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("[,$[:space:]]", "", as.character(x))))
to_bool <- function(x) {
  y <- tolower(trimws(as.character(x)))
  fifelse(y %in% c("1", "true", "y", "yes"), 1L, fifelse(y %in% c("0", "false", "n", "no"), 0L, NA_integer_))
}
to_cik  <- function(x) { x <- trimws(as.character(x)); sub("^0+(?=\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE) }
clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  bad <- which(!is.na(x) & !validUTF8(x))
  if (length(bad)) x[bad] <- iconv(x[bad], "latin1", "UTF-8", sub = "?")
  ctl <- which(grepl("[\r\n\t]", x))
  if (length(ctl)) x[ctl] <- gsub("[\r\n\t]+", " ", x[ctl])
  x <- trimws(x)
  x[!is.na(x) & !nzchar(x)] <- NA_character_
  x
}

conform <- function(dt, tbl) {
  cols <- SCHEMA[[tbl]]
  dt <- if (is.null(dt) || !ncol(dt)) as.data.table(setNames(replicate(length(cols), character(), FALSE), cols))
        else as.data.table(dt)
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(dt))
  if (length(miss)) dt[, (miss) := NA_character_]
  dt <- dt[, ..cols]
  for (c in cols) {
    v <- dt[[c]]
    v <- if (c %in% DATE_COLS) to_iso(v) else if (c %in% NUM_COLS) to_num(v)
         else if (c %in% BOOL_COLS) to_bool(v) else if (c %in% CIK_COLS) clean_text(to_cik(v))
         else clean_text(v)
    set(dt, j = c, value = v)
  }
  dt[]
}

# ---- Quarter helpers ----
q_start <- function(d) as.Date(sprintf("%s-%02d-01", format(d, "%Y"), (as.integer(format(d, "%m")) - 1) %/% 3 * 3 + 1))
q_end   <- function(d) { s <- q_start(d); as.Date(sapply(s, function(x) seq(x, by = "3 months", length.out = 2)[2]), origin = "1970-01-01") - 1 }
qtag    <- function(d) paste0(format(d, "%Y"), "q", (as.integer(format(d, "%m")) - 1) %/% 3 + 1)
tag_start <- function(tag) as.Date(sprintf("%s-%02d-01", substr(tag, 1, 4), (as.integer(substr(tag, 6, 6)) - 1) * 3 + 1))
```

```{r storage}
# ---- Storage: tables/<table>/<batch>.csv.gz, batch = sec_YYYYqN or xml_YYYYqN ----
tpath <- function(tbl, batch) file.path(D$tables, tolower(tbl), paste0(batch, ".csv.gz"))

write_tbl <- function(dt, tbl, batch) {
  f <- tpath(tbl, batch)
  dir.create(dirname(f), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  tmp <- paste0(f, ".tmp")
  fwrite(dt, tmp, compress = "gzip", na = "", scipen = 50L)
  replace_file(tmp, f)
}
read_tbl <- function(tbl, batch) {
  f <- tpath(tbl, batch)
  if (!file.exists(f)) return(conform(NULL, tbl))
  conform(fread(f, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "", encoding = "UTF-8", showProgress = FALSE), tbl)
}
delete_batch <- function(batch) {
  for (tbl in TABLES) unlink(tpath(tbl, batch))
  unlink(reg_file(batch))
}

# Registry: accession numbers stored in each batch, rebuilt from disk whenever out of date.
reg_file <- function(batch) file.path(D$registry, paste0(batch, ".rds"))
load_registry <- function() {
  batches <- sub("\\.csv\\.gz$", "", list.files(file.path(D$tables, "submission"), pattern = "\\.csv\\.gz$"))
  stale <- setdiff(sub("\\.rds$", "", list.files(D$registry, pattern = "\\.rds$")), batches)
  unlink(reg_file(stale))
  reg <- lapply(batches, function(b) {
    rf <- reg_file(b); sf <- tpath("SUBMISSION", b)
    if (!file.exists(rf) || file.mtime(rf) < file.mtime(sf)) {
      acc <- fread(sf, select = "ACCESSION_NUMBER", colClasses = "character", na.strings = "",
                   showProgress = FALSE)$ACCESSION_NUMBER
      saveRDS(unique(acc), rf)
    }
    readRDS(rf)
  })
  setNames(reg, batches)
}

# Failures: filings in EDGAR's index that could not be stored, with the reason.
FAIL_FILE <- file.path(D$state, "failures.csv")
load_failures <- function() {
  f <- if (file.exists(FAIL_FILE)) fread(FAIL_FILE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "") else
    data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = character(), FORM = character(), DATE_FILED = character(), FILENAME = character(),
               REASON = character(), PERSISTENT_FAILS = character(), TRANSIENT_FAILS = character(),
               LAST_ATTEMPT = character())
  f[, `:=`(DATE_FILED = as.IDate(DATE_FILED), PERSISTENT_FAILS = as.integer(PERSISTENT_FAILS),
           TRANSIENT_FAILS = as.integer(TRANSIENT_FAILS))]
  f[]
}
save_failures <- function(f) { tmp <- paste0(FAIL_FILE, ".tmp"); fwrite(f, tmp); replace_file(tmp, FAIL_FILE) }
```

```{r xml-parser}
# ---- Parse one filing (full submission .txt) into the eight tables ----
xv <- function(nodes, xp) {                      # text of first match under each node
  v <- trimws(gsub("\\s+", " ", xml_text(xml_find_first(nodes, xp))))
  v[!is.na(v) & !nzchar(v)] <- NA_character_
  v
}
xfn <- function(nodes, xp) vapply(seq_along(nodes), function(i) {   # footnote ids under each node
  ids <- xml_attr(xml_find_all(nodes[[i]], xp), "id")
  if (length(ids)) paste(ids, collapse = ",") else NA_character_
}, character(1))

vf <- function(col, path) setNames(c(paste0("./", path, "/value"), paste0("./", path, "/footnoteId")),
                                   c(col, paste0(col, "_FN")))
CODING <- c(TRANS_FORM_TYPE = "./transactionCoding/transactionFormType",
            TRANS_CODE = "./transactionCoding/transactionCode",
            EQUITY_SWAP_INVOLVED = "./transactionCoding/equitySwapInvolved",
            EQUITY_SWAP_TRANS_CD_FN = "./transactionCoding/footnoteId")
OWN_TAIL <- c(vf("SHRS_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "postTransactionAmounts/sharesOwnedFollowingTransaction"),
              vf("VALU_OWND_FOLWNG_TRANS", "postTransactionAmounts/valueOwnedFollowingTransaction"),
              vf("DIRECT_INDIRECT_OWNERSHIP", "ownershipNature/directOrIndirectOwnership"),
              vf("NATURE_OF_OWNERSHIP", "ownershipNature/natureOfOwnership"))
UNDERLYING <- c(vf("UNDLYNG_SEC_TITLE", "underlyingSecurity/underlyingSecurityTitle"),
                vf("UNDLYNG_SEC_SHARES", "underlyingSecurity/underlyingSecurityShares"),
                vf("UNDLYNG_SEC_VALUE", "underlyingSecurity/underlyingSecurityValue"))

XSPEC <- list(
  NONDERIV_TRANS = list(node = "./nonDerivativeTable/nonDerivativeTransaction", sk = "NONDERIV_TRANS_SK",
    cols = c(vf("SECURITY_TITLE", "securityTitle"), vf("TRANS_DATE", "transactionDate"),
             vf("DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE", "deemedExecutionDate"), CODING,
             vf("TRANS_TIMELINESS", "transactionTimeliness"),
             vf("TRANS_SHARES", "transactionAmounts/transactionShares"),
             vf("TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "transactionAmounts/transactionPricePerShare"),
             vf("TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD", "transactionAmounts/transactionAcquiredDisposedCode"), OWN_TAIL)),
  NONDERIV_HOLDING = list(node = "./nonDerivativeTable/nonDerivativeHolding", sk = "NONDERIV_HOLDING_SK",
    cols = c(vf("SECURITY_TITLE", "securityTitle"),
             TRANS_FORM_TYPE = ".//transactionFormType", TRANS_FORM_TYPE_FN = "./transactionCoding/footnoteId",
             OWN_TAIL)),
  DERIV_TRANS = list(node = "./derivativeTable/derivativeTransaction", sk = "DERIV_TRANS_SK",
    cols = c(vf("SECURITY_TITLE", "securityTitle"), vf("CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE", "conversionOrExercisePrice"),
             vf("TRANS_DATE", "transactionDate"), vf("DEEMED_EXECUTION_DATE", "deemedExecutionDate"), CODING,
             vf("TRANS_TIMELINESS", "transactionTimeliness"),
             vf("TRANS_SHARES", "transactionAmounts/transactionShares"),
             vf("TRANS_TOTAL_VALUE", "transactionAmounts/transactionTotalValue"),
             vf("TRANS_PRICEPERSHARE", "transactionAmounts/transactionPricePerShare"),
             vf("TRANS_ACQUIRED_DISP_CD", "transactionAmounts/transactionAcquiredDisposedCode"),
             vf("EXCERCISE_DATE", "exerciseDate"), vf("EXPIRATION_DATE", "expirationDate"),
             UNDERLYING, OWN_TAIL)),
  DERIV_HOLDING = list(node = "./derivativeTable/derivativeHolding", sk = "DERIV_HOLDING_SK",
    cols = c(vf("SECURITY_TITLE", "securityTitle"), vf("CONV_EXERCISE_PRICE", "conversionOrExercisePrice"),
             TRANS_FORM_TYPE = ".//transactionFormType", TRANS_FORM_TYPE_FN = "./transactionCoding/footnoteId",
             vf("EXERCISE_DATE", "exerciseDate"), vf("EXPIRATION_DATE", "expirationDate"),
             UNDERLYING, OWN_TAIL))
)
stopifnot(all(unlist(lapply(names(XSPEC), function(t) names(XSPEC[[t]]$cols) %in% SCHEMA[[t]]))))

rows_from <- function(nodes, cols, acc, sk) {
  if (!length(nodes)) return(NULL)
  out <- lapply(names(cols), function(c) if (endsWith(c, "_FN")) xfn(nodes, cols[[c]]) else xv(nodes, cols[[c]]))
  dt <- as.data.table(setNames(out, names(cols)))
  dt[, ACCESSION_NUMBER := acc]
  if (!is.null(sk)) dt[, (sk) := as.character(seq_len(.N))]
  dt
}

parse_filing <- function(raw, acc, date_fallback) {
  txt <- raw_text(raw)
  fd <- regmatches(txt, regexpr("FILED AS OF DATE:\\s*\\d{8}", txt, useBytes = TRUE))
  filing_date <- if (length(fd)) gsub("\\D", "", fd) else as.character(date_fallback)

  blocks <- regmatches(txt, gregexpr("(?s)<XML>.*?</XML>", txt, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE))[[1]]
  blocks <- blocks[grepl("<ownershipDocument", blocks, useBytes = TRUE)]
  if (!length(blocks)) return(list(error = "no ownership XML in filing"))
  xml <- sub("(?s)^<XML>\\s*", "", sub("(?s)\\s*</XML>$", "", blocks[1], perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE),
             perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  doc <- tryCatch(read_xml(charToRaw(xml)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(doc)) doc <- tryCatch(read_xml(charToRaw(xml), options = c("RECOVER", "NOERROR")),
                                    error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(doc)) return(list(error = "ownership XML could not be parsed"))
  xml_ns_strip(doc)
  root <- if (xml_name(doc) == "ownershipDocument") doc else xml_find_first(doc, "//ownershipDocument")
  if (inherits(root, "xml_missing")) return(list(error = "no ownershipDocument element"))

  out <- list()
  out$SUBMISSION <- data.table(
    ACCESSION_NUMBER = acc, FILING_DATE = filing_date,
    PERIOD_OF_REPORT = xv(root, "./periodOfReport"), DATE_OF_ORIG_SUB = xv(root, "./dateOfOriginalSubmission"),
    NO_SECURITIES_OWNED = xv(root, "./noSecuritiesOwned"), NOT_SUBJECT_SEC16 = xv(root, "./notSubjectToSection16"),
    FORM3_HOLDING_REPORTED = xv(root, "./form3HoldingsReported"),
    FORM4_TRANS_REPORTED = xv(root, "./form4TransactionsReported"), DOCUMENT_TYPE = xv(root, "./documentType"),
    ISSUERCIK = xv(root, "./issuer/issuerCik"), ISSUERNAME = xv(root, "./issuer/issuerName"),
    ISSUERTRADINGSYMBOL = xv(root, "./issuer/issuerTradingSymbol"), REMARKS = xv(root, "./remarks"),
    AFF10B5ONE = xv(root, "./aff10b5One"), SOURCE = "EDGAR_XML")

  on <- xml_find_all(root, "./reportingOwner")
  if (length(on)) {
    flags <- sapply(c("isDirector", "isOfficer", "isTenPercentOwner", "isOther"),
                    function(f) to_bool(xv(on, paste0("./reportingOwnerRelationship/", f))))
    flags <- matrix(flags, nrow = length(on))
    rel <- apply(flags, 1, function(r) paste(c("Director", "Officer", "TenPercentOwner", "Other")[!is.na(r) & r == 1L],
                                             collapse = ","))
    out$REPORTINGOWNER <- data.table(
      ACCESSION_NUMBER = acc, RPTOWNERCIK = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerId/rptOwnerCik"),
      RPTOWNERNAME = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerId/rptOwnerName"), RPTOWNER_RELATIONSHIP = rel,
      RPTOWNER_TITLE = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerRelationship/officerTitle"),
      RPTOWNER_TXT = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerRelationship/otherText"),
      RPTOWNER_STREET1 = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerStreet1"),
      RPTOWNER_STREET2 = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerStreet2"),
      RPTOWNER_CITY = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerCity"),
      RPTOWNER_STATE = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerState"),
      RPTOWNER_ZIPCODE = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerZipCode"),
      RPTOWNER_STATE_DESC = xv(on, "./reportingOwnerAddress/rptOwnerStateDescription"),
      IS_DIRECTOR = flags[, 1], IS_OFFICER = flags[, 2], IS_TENPERCENTOWNER = flags[, 3], IS_OTHER = flags[, 4])
  }
  for (t in names(XSPEC))
    out[[t]] <- rows_from(xml_find_all(root, XSPEC[[t]]$node), XSPEC[[t]]$cols, acc, XSPEC[[t]]$sk)

  fnodes <- xml_find_all(root, "./footnotes/footnote")
  if (length(fnodes))
    out$FOOTNOTES <- data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = acc, FOOTNOTE_ID = xml_attr(fnodes, "id"),
                                FOOTNOTE_TXT = gsub("\\s+", " ", trimws(xml_text(fnodes))))
  snodes <- xml_find_all(root, "./ownerSignature")
  if (length(snodes))
    out$OWNER_SIGNATURE <- data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = acc, OWNERSIGNATURENAME = xv(snodes, "./signatureName"),
                                      OWNERSIGNATUREDATE = xv(snodes, "./signatureDate"))
  out
}

# Add parsed filings to xml_YYYYqN batches (by filing date), replacing any earlier copy.
append_xml <- function(tabs, reg) {
  sub <- tabs$SUBMISSION
  bq <- fifelse(is.na(sub$FILING_DATE), "unknown", qtag(as.Date(fcoalesce(sub$FILING_DATE, "1970-01-01"))))
  for (b in unique(paste0("xml_", bq))) {
    accs <- sub$ACCESSION_NUMBER[paste0("xml_", bq) == b]
    for (tbl in WRITE_ORDER) {
      old <- read_tbl(tbl, b)
      new <- tabs[[tbl]][ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% accs]
      comb <- rbind(old[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% accs], new)
      setorderv(comb, "ACCESSION_NUMBER")
      write_tbl(comb, tbl, b)
    }
    reg[[b]] <- unique(c(setdiff(reg[[b]] %||% character(), accs), accs))
    saveRDS(reg[[b]], reg_file(b))
  }
  reg
}
```

```{r index-functions}
# ---- EDGAR index parsing ----
EMPTY_IDX <- function() data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = character(), FORM = character(),
                                   DATE_FILED = as.IDate(character()), FILENAME = character())
parse_index_file <- function(path) {
  con <- gzfile(path, "rb")
  lines <- readLines(con, warn = FALSE)
  close(con)
  # Row format: CIK|Company Name|Form Type|Date Filed|Filename (company names may contain "|")
  lines <- trimws(lines[grepl("\\|[345](/A)?\\|\\d{4}-?\\d{2}-?\\d{2}\\|edgar/", lines, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)])
  if (!length(lines)) return(EMPTY_IDX())
  file <- sub("^.*\\|", "", lines, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  rest <- sub("\\|[^|]*$", "", lines, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  date <- sub("^.*\\|", "", rest, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  rest <- sub("\\|[^|]*$", "", rest, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  form <- sub("^.*\\|", "", rest, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)
  dt <- data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = sub("\\.txt$", "", sub("^.*/", "", file)), FORM = form,
                   DATE_FILED = as.IDate(to_iso(date)), FILENAME = file)
  unique(dt[FORM %in% FORMS & grepl(ACC_RE, ACCESSION_NUMBER) & !is.na(DATE_FILED)], by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER")
}

# Full quarterly index. Cached permanently once fetched more than 7 days after quarter end.
get_quarter_index <- function(qs) {
  tag <- qtag(qs)
  cache <- file.path(D$index, paste0(tag, ".rds"))
  if (file.exists(cache)) {
    c0 <- readRDS(cache)
    if (c0$fetched > q_end(qs) + 7) return(list(idx = c0$idx, ok = TRUE))
  }
  for (f in c("master.gz", "master.idx")) {
    url <- sprintf("%s/Archives/edgar/full-index/%s/QTR%s/%s", BASE, substr(tag, 1, 4), substr(tag, 6, 6), f)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = paste0("_", f))
    st <- sec_fetch_disk(url, tmp)
    if (st == 200L) {
      idx <- parse_index_file(tmp)
      unlink(tmp)
      if (!nrow(idx) && q_end(qs) < AS_OF - 7)
        stop("EDGAR index for ", tag, " was downloaded but no Form 3/4/5 rows were recognized. ",
             "The index format may have changed; stopping so nothing is silently missed.")
      saveRDS(list(fetched = Sys.Date(), idx = idx), cache)
      return(list(idx = idx, ok = TRUE))
    }
  }
  if (file.exists(cache)) {
    log_msg("Could not refresh EDGAR index for ", tag, "; using the copy from ", c0$fetched)
    return(list(idx = c0$idx, ok = FALSE))
  }
  # A brand-new quarter may not have a full index yet; the daily indexes cover it.
  list(idx = EMPTY_IDX(), ok = AS_OF - qs <= 10)
}

get_daily_index <- function(d) {
  url <- sprintf("%s/Archives/edgar/daily-index/%s/QTR%s/master.%s.idx",
                 BASE, format(d, "%Y"), substr(qtag(d), 6, 6), format(d, "%Y%m%d"))
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".idx")
  st <- sec_fetch_disk(url, tmp)
  if (st != 200L) return(NULL)              # weekend, holiday, or not published yet
  on.exit(unlink(tmp))
  parse_index_file(tmp)
}

# Today's filings (EDGAR's live feed). Best effort; tomorrow's index confirms them.
get_current_filings <- function() {
  rx1 <- function(x, p) vapply(regmatches(x, regexec(p, x, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE)),
                               function(v) if (length(v) >= 2) v[2] else NA_character_, character(1))
  out <- list(); seen <- character()
  for (ty in unique(sub("/A$", "", FORMS))) {
    for (pg in 0:49) {
      url <- sprintf("%s/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcurrent&type=%s&company=&dateb=&owner=include&start=%d&count=100&output=atom",
                     BASE, ty, pg * 100)
      r <- sec_fetch(url)
      if (r$status != 200L) break
      txt <- raw_text(r$raw)
      ent <- regmatches(txt, gregexpr("(?s)<entry>.*?</entry>", txt, perl = TRUE, useBytes = TRUE))[[1]]
      if (!length(ent)) break
      acc  <- rx1(ent, "accession-number=(\\d{10}-\\d{2}-\\d{6})")
      acc  <- fifelse(is.na(acc), rx1(ent, "(\\d{10}-\\d{2}-\\d{6})"), acc)
      cik  <- rx1(ent, "/Archives/edgar/data/(\\d+)/")
      form <- rx1(ent, "term=\"([^\"]+)\"")
      upd  <- as.Date(substr(rx1(ent, "<updated>([^<]+)</updated>"), 1, 10))
      new  <- !is.na(acc) & !acc %in% seen
      if (!any(new)) break
      seen <- c(seen, acc)
      keep <- new & form %in% FORMS & !is.na(cik) & (is.na(upd) | upd == AS_OF)
      if (any(keep))
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(ACCESSION_NUMBER = acc[keep], FORM = form[keep],
                                             DATE_FILED = as.IDate(AS_OF),
                                             FILENAME = sprintf("edgar/data/%s/%s.txt", cik[keep], acc[keep]))
      if (length(ent) < 100 || all(!is.na(upd) & upd < AS_OF)) break
    }
  }
  res <- rbindlist(out)
  if (nrow(res)) unique(res, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER") else NULL
}
```

## 1. SEC quarterly data sets

```{r step1-sec}
t1 <- Sys.time()
SEC_STATE <- file.path(D$state, "sec_datasets.csv")
sec_state <- if (file.exists(SEC_STATE)) fread(SEC_STATE, colClasses = "character") else
  data.table(tag = character(), url = character(), size = character(), last_modified = character(),
             ingested_at = character())

page <- sec_fetch(paste0(BASE, "/data-research/sec-markets-data/insider-transactions-data-sets"))
if (page$status != 200L) stop("Could not load the SEC Insider Transactions Data Sets page (HTTP ", page$status, ").")
html  <- raw_text(page$raw)
hrefs <- regmatches(html, gregexpr("href=[\"'][^\"']*?\\d{4}q[1-4]_form345\\.zip[\"']", html, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
hrefs <- gsub("^href=[\"']|[\"']$", "", hrefs)
urls  <- ifelse(grepl("^https?://", hrefs), sub("^https?://[^/]+", BASE, hrefs),
                paste0(BASE, ifelse(startsWith(hrefs, "/"), "", "/"), hrefs))
sec_list <- unique(data.table(tag = sub(".*(\\d{4}q[1-4])_form345\\.zip$", "\\1", urls), url = urls), by = "tag")
sec_list <- sec_list[q_end(tag_start(tag)) >= START & tag_start(tag) <= AS_OF][order(tag)]
if (!nrow(sec_list)) stop("No quarterly data set links were found on the SEC page. Its layout may have changed.")

expected <- qtag(seq(max(q_start(START), as.Date("2006-01-01")), q_start(AS_OF), by = "quarter"))
not_listed <- setdiff(expected, sec_list$tag)
if (length(not_listed))
  log_msg("SEC data sets not (yet) published for: ", paste(not_listed, collapse = ", "),
          ". Those filings are fetched individually from EDGAR.")

reg <- load_registry()

ingest_sec <- function(zipf, tag) {
  batch <- paste0("sec_", tag)
  inside <- unzip(zipf, list = TRUE)$Name
  ex <- tempfile("sec_")
  dir.create(ex)
  on.exit(unlink(ex, recursive = TRUE), add = TRUE)
  tabs <- list()
  for (tbl in TABLES) {
    f <- inside[toupper(basename(inside)) == paste0(tbl, ".TSV")]
    if (!length(f)) {
      if (tbl == "SUBMISSION") stop(basename(zipf), " contains no SUBMISSION.tsv")
      log_msg(tag, ": ", tbl, ".tsv not in zip; treated as empty")
      tabs[[tbl]] <- conform(NULL, tbl)
      next
    }
    path <- unzip(zipf, files = f[1], exdir = ex, junkpaths = TRUE)
    dt <- fread(path, sep = "\t", quote = "", header = TRUE, colClasses = "character", na.strings = "",
                fill = TRUE, encoding = "UTF-8", showProgress = FALSE)
    setnames(dt, toupper(trimws(sub("^\ufeff", "", names(dt)))))
    miss <- setdiff(REQUIRED[[tbl]] %||% "ACCESSION_NUMBER", names(dt))
    if (length(miss)) stop(tag, " ", tbl, " is missing required columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "),
                           ". The SEC may have changed its format; stopping so nothing is silently wrong.")
    opt <- setdiff(setdiff(SCHEMA[[tbl]], ADDED_COLS), names(dt))
    if (length(opt)) log_msg(tag, " ", tbl, ": columns not in this quarter's file (left blank): ", paste(opt, collapse = ", "))
    bad <- is.na(dt$ACCESSION_NUMBER) | !grepl(ACC_RE, dt$ACCESSION_NUMBER)
    if (any(bad)) {
      log_msg(tag, " ", tbl, ": dropped ", sum(bad), " malformed row(s)")
      dt <- dt[!bad]
    }
    if (tbl == "REPORTINGOWNER" && "RPTOWNER_RELATIONSHIP" %in% names(dt)) {
      rel <- toupper(fcoalesce(dt$RPTOWNER_RELATIONSHIP, ""))
      dt[, `:=`(IS_DIRECTOR = as.integer(grepl("DIRECTOR", rel)), IS_OFFICER = as.integer(grepl("OFFICER", rel)),
                IS_TENPERCENTOWNER = as.integer(grepl("TEN|10", rel)), IS_OTHER = as.integer(grepl("OTHER", rel)))]
    }
    if (tbl == "SUBMISSION") dt[, SOURCE := "SEC_DATASET"]
    dt <- conform(dt, tbl)
    tabs[[tbl]] <- if (tbl == "SUBMISSION") unique(dt, by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER") else unique(dt)
  }
  # A filing stored in another SEC quarter stays there; drop it here.
  other <- unlist(reg[setdiff(grep("^sec_", names(reg), value = TRUE), batch)], use.names = FALSE)
  dup <- intersect(tabs$SUBMISSION$ACCESSION_NUMBER, other)
  if (length(dup)) log_msg(tag, ": ", length(dup), " filing(s) already stored from another SEC quarter; kept there")
  keep <- setdiff(tabs$SUBMISSION$ACCESSION_NUMBER, dup)
  for (tbl in setdiff(TABLES, "SUBMISSION")) {
    orphans <- sum(!tabs[[tbl]]$ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% tabs$SUBMISSION$ACCESSION_NUMBER)
    if (orphans) log_msg(tag, " ", tbl, ": ", orphans, " row(s) with no SUBMISSION row removed")
  }
  for (tbl in TABLES) tabs[[tbl]] <- tabs[[tbl]][ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% keep]
  for (tbl in WRITE_ORDER) write_tbl(tabs[[tbl]], tbl, batch)
  saveRDS(keep, reg_file(batch))
  keep
}

# SEC versions replace parsed copies of the same filing.
purge_xml <- function(accs) {
  for (b in grep("^xml_", names(reg), value = TRUE)) {
    hit <- reg[[b]] %in% accs
    if (!any(hit)) next
    keep <- reg[[b]][!hit]
    if (!length(keep)) {
      delete_batch(b)
      reg[[b]] <<- NULL
    } else {
      for (tbl in WRITE_ORDER) { dt <- read_tbl(tbl, b); write_tbl(dt[ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% keep], tbl, b) }
      saveRDS(keep, reg_file(b))
      reg[[b]] <<- keep
    }
    log_msg(b, ": ", sum(hit), " parsed filing(s) replaced by the SEC data set version")
  }
}

sec_log <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sec_list))) {
  tag <- sec_list$tag[i]; url <- sec_list$url[i]; batch <- paste0("sec_", tag)
  h <- sec_fetch(url, nobody = TRUE)
  hdr <- if (h$status == 200L) parse_headers_list(h$headers) else list()
  size <- as.character(hdr[["content-length"]] %||% NA)
  lm   <- as.character(hdr[["last-modified"]] %||% NA)
  prev <- sec_state[tag == sec_list$tag[i]]
  have_files <- file.exists(tpath("SUBMISSION", batch))
  if (nrow(prev) && have_files && (h$status != 200L || (identical(prev$size, size) && identical(prev$last_modified, lm)))) {
    if (h$status != 200L) log_msg(tag, ": could not check for an SEC update (HTTP ", h$status, "); keeping stored copy")
    next
  }
  reason <- if (!nrow(prev) || !have_files) "new" else "re-published by the SEC"
  zipf <- file.path(D$zips, basename(url))
  st <- sec_fetch_disk(url, zipf)
  if (st != 200L) { log_msg(tag, ": download failed (HTTP ", st, "); filings will be fetched individually"); next }
  accs <- ingest_sec(zipf, tag)
  reg[[batch]] <- accs
  purge_xml(accs)
  if (!isTRUE(P$keep_zips)) unlink(zipf)
  sec_state <- rbind(sec_state[tag != sec_list$tag[i]],
                     data.table(tag = sec_list$tag[i], url = url, size = size, last_modified = lm,
                                ingested_at = format(Sys.time())))
  tmp <- paste0(SEC_STATE, ".tmp"); fwrite(sec_state, tmp); replace_file(tmp, SEC_STATE)
  sec_log[[length(sec_log) + 1]] <- data.table(Quarter = tag, Action = reason, Filings = length(accs))
  log_msg(tag, ": ingested (", reason, "), ", length(accs), " filings")
}
sec_log <- rbindlist(sec_log)
say(sprintf("SEC data sets available: %d (%s to %s). Ingested this run: %d. Took %s.",
            nrow(sec_list), min(sec_list$tag), max(sec_list$tag), nrow(sec_log), fmt_min(t1)))
if (nrow(sec_log)) show(sec_log)
```

## 2. EDGAR filing index (the complete list)

```{r step2-index}
t2 <- Sys.time()
have <- unique(unlist(reg, use.names = FALSE))
fails <- load_failures()
fails <- fails[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% have]             # stored since (e.g. by a new SEC quarter)

quarters <- seq(q_start(START), q_start(AS_OF), by = "quarter")
coverage <- vector("list", length(quarters))
todo <- vector("list", length(quarters))
recent_known <- character()
for (i in seq_along(quarters)) {
  r <- get_quarter_index(quarters[i])
  idx <- r$idx[DATE_FILED >= START & DATE_FILED <= AS_OF]
  if (quarters[i] >= q_start(AS_OF - 20)) recent_known <- c(recent_known, idx$ACCESSION_NUMBER)
  miss <- idx[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% have]
  coverage[[i]] <- data.table(QUARTER = qtag(quarters[i]), INDEX_OK = r$ok, IN_INDEX = nrow(idx))
  todo[[i]] <- miss
}
coverage <- rbindlist(coverage)

# Recent days: daily indexes (published nightly) plus today's live feed.
d_to <- if (LIVE) AS_OF - 1 else AS_OF                  # today's daily index appears only at night
days <- if (d_to >= max(START, AS_OF - 10)) seq(max(START, AS_OF - 10), d_to, by = "day") else as.Date(character())
days <- days[!format(days, "%u") %in% c("6", "7")]
recent <- rbindlist(c(lapply(days, get_daily_index), list(if (LIVE) get_current_filings())))
if (nrow(recent)) {
  recent <- unique(recent[DATE_FILED >= START & DATE_FILED <= AS_OF & !ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% recent_known],
                   by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER")
  if (nrow(recent)) {
    extra <- recent[, .(EXTRA = .N), by = .(QUARTER = qtag(as.Date(DATE_FILED)))]
    coverage <- merge(coverage, extra, by = "QUARTER", all.x = TRUE)
    coverage[, IN_INDEX := IN_INDEX + fcoalesce(EXTRA, 0L)][, EXTRA := NULL]
  }
  todo[[length(todo) + 1]] <- recent[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% have]
}
todo <- unique(rbindlist(todo), by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER")
setorder(todo, DATE_FILED)

given_up <- fails[PERSISTENT_FAILS >= MAXPF, ACCESSION_NUMBER]
skipped  <- todo[ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% given_up]
todo     <- todo[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% given_up]

say(sprintf("Filings in EDGAR's index %s to %s: %s. Already stored: %s. To download now: %s%s. Took %s.",
            START, AS_OF, format(sum(coverage$IN_INDEX), big.mark = ","),
            format(sum(coverage$IN_INDEX) - nrow(todo) - nrow(skipped), big.mark = ","),
            format(nrow(todo), big.mark = ","),
            if (nrow(skipped)) sprintf(" (%d unrecoverable skipped)", nrow(skipped)) else "", fmt_min(t2)))
if (nrow(todo)) {
  est <- nrow(todo) / RATE / 60 * 1.05
  say(sprintf("Estimated download time at %g requests/sec: about %s.", RATE,
              if (est < 1) sprintf("%.0f sec", est * 60) else if (est < 120) sprintf("%.0f min", est) else sprintf("%.1f hours", est / 60)))
}
```

## 3. Download missing filings

```{r step3-fetch}
t3 <- Sys.time()
stored_now <- character()
if (nrow(todo)) {
  chunks <- split(seq_len(nrow(todo)), ceiling(seq_len(nrow(todo)) / CHUNK))
  log_msg("Fetching ", nrow(todo), " filings in ", length(chunks), " chunk(s)")
  for (ci in seq_along(chunks)) {
    rows <- todo[chunks[[ci]]]
    urls <- paste0(BASE, "/Archives/", rows$FILENAME)
    res  <- fetch_many(urls)
    st   <- vapply(res, `[[`, integer(1), "status")
    for (j in which(!st %in% c(200L, 404L))) { res[[j]] <- sec_fetch(urls[j]); st[j] <- res[[j]]$status }

    parsed  <- vector("list", nrow(rows))
    outcome <- character(nrow(rows))
    for (j in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
      if (st[j] == 404L) { outcome[j] <- "not found on EDGAR"; next }
      if (st[j] != 200L) { outcome[j] <- sprintf("download failed (HTTP %d)", st[j]); next }
      p <- tryCatch(parse_filing(res[[j]]$raw, rows$ACCESSION_NUMBER[j], rows$DATE_FILED[j]),
                    error = function(e) list(error = paste("parse error:", conditionMessage(e))))
      if (!is.null(p$error)) outcome[j] <- p$error else { parsed[[j]] <- p; outcome[j] <- "ok" }
    }
    rm(res)
    ok <- outcome == "ok"
    if (any(ok)) {
      tabs <- setNames(lapply(TABLES, function(t) conform(rbindlist(lapply(parsed[ok], `[[`, t), fill = TRUE), t)), TABLES)
      reg <- append_xml(tabs, reg)
      stored_now <- c(stored_now, rows$ACCESSION_NUMBER[ok])
    }

    # Update the failure log: successes cleared, failures counted by kind.
    fails <- fails[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% rows$ACCESSION_NUMBER[ok]]
    if (any(!ok)) {
      bad <- rows[!ok][, REASON := outcome[!ok]]
      transient <- startsWith(bad$REASON, "download failed")
      prev <- fails[match(bad$ACCESSION_NUMBER, fails$ACCESSION_NUMBER)]
      bad[, `:=`(PERSISTENT_FAILS = fcoalesce(prev$PERSISTENT_FAILS, 0L) + as.integer(!transient),
                 TRANSIENT_FAILS  = fcoalesce(prev$TRANSIENT_FAILS, 0L) + as.integer(transient),
                 LAST_ATTEMPT = format(Sys.time()))]
      fails <- rbind(fails[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% bad$ACCESSION_NUMBER], bad, fill = TRUE)
    }
    save_failures(fails)

    done <- sum(lengths(chunks[seq_len(ci)]))
    el <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), t3, units = "mins"))
    left <- el / done * (nrow(todo) - done)
    log_msg(sprintf("Chunk %d/%d: %s/%s filings done, %d failed this chunk | %s elapsed, ~%s left",
                    ci, length(chunks), format(done, big.mark = ","), format(nrow(todo), big.mark = ","), sum(!ok),
                    fmt_min(t3), if (left < 1) sprintf("%.0f sec", left * 60) else if (left < 120) sprintf("%.0f min", left)
                    else sprintf("%.1f hours", left / 60)))
  }
}
say(sprintf("Downloaded and stored %s filing(s) in %s.", format(length(stored_now), big.mark = ","), fmt_min(t3)))
```

## 4. Completeness report

```{r step4-report}
have <- unique(unlist(reg, use.names = FALSE))
all_acc <- unlist(reg, use.names = FALSE)
n_dup <- sum(duplicated(all_acc))

missing <- rbind(todo[!ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% have], skipped)
missing[, QUARTER := qtag(as.Date(DATE_FILED))]
missing[, STATUS := fifelse(ACCESSION_NUMBER %in% fails[PERSISTENT_FAILS >= MAXPF, ACCESSION_NUMBER],
                            "unrecoverable", "will retry next run")]
cov <- merge(coverage, missing[, .(NOT_STORED = .N, UNRECOVERABLE = sum(STATUS == "unrecoverable")), by = QUARTER],
             by = "QUARTER", all.x = TRUE)
cov[is.na(NOT_STORED), `:=`(NOT_STORED = 0L, UNRECOVERABLE = 0L)]
cov[, STORED := IN_INDEX - NOT_STORED]
cov[, PCT_STORED := round(100 * STORED / pmax(IN_INDEX, 1), 3)]
fwrite(cov, file.path(D$state, "completeness_by_quarter.csv"))

index_problems <- cov[INDEX_OK == FALSE, QUARTER]
complete <- !length(index_problems) && !nrow(missing) && n_dup == 0
verdict <- if (complete) {
  sprintf("COMPLETE: all %s Form %s filings in EDGAR's index from %s to %s are stored.",
          format(sum(cov$IN_INDEX), big.mark = ","), paste(FORMS, collapse = "/"), START, AS_OF)
} else {
  paste(c(
    if (nrow(missing)) sprintf("%s filing(s) in EDGAR's index are not stored (%d unrecoverable, %d will be retried next run). See %s.",
                               format(nrow(missing), big.mark = ","), sum(missing$STATUS == "unrecoverable"),
                               sum(missing$STATUS != "unrecoverable"), FAIL_FILE),
    if (length(index_problems)) sprintf("EDGAR's index could not be checked for: %s.", paste(index_problems, collapse = ", ")),
    if (n_dup) sprintf("%d filing(s) are stored in more than one batch.", n_dup)), collapse = " ")
}
log_msg(if (complete) verdict else paste("INCOMPLETE:", verdict))
say(if (complete) verdict else paste("INCOMPLETE:", verdict))
```

```{r step4-table}
yr <- cov[, .(`In EDGAR index` = sum(IN_INDEX), Stored = sum(STORED), `Not stored` = sum(NOT_STORED),
              `% stored` = round(100 * sum(STORED) / pmax(sum(IN_INDEX), 1), 3)), by = .(Year = substr(QUARTER, 1, 4))]
show(yr)
if (nrow(missing)) {
  reasons <- merge(missing[, .(ACCESSION_NUMBER, STATUS)], fails[, .(ACCESSION_NUMBER, REASON)],
                   by = "ACCESSION_NUMBER", all.x = TRUE)[, .N, by = .(REASON = fcoalesce(REASON, "not attempted"), STATUS)]
  say("")
  show(reasons[order(-N)], caption = "Filings not stored, by reason")
}
```

## 5. Stored data

```{r step5-summary}
sizes <- sapply(TABLES, function(t) sum(file.size(list.files(file.path(D$tables, tolower(t)), full.names = TRUE))))
src <- data.table(batch = names(reg), filings = lengths(reg))[, .(Filings = sum(filings)),
                  by = .(Source = fifelse(startsWith(batch, "sec_"), "SEC quarterly data set", "Parsed from EDGAR filing"))]
show(src)
say("")
say(sprintf("Total on disk: %.1f MB in %s", sum(sizes) / 1e6, normalizePath(D$tables)))
btags <- sub("^(sec|xml)_", "", names(reg))
latest_b <- names(reg)[btags != "unknown" & btags == max(btags[btags != "unknown"])]
if (length(latest_b))
  say(sprintf("Latest filing date stored: %s",
              max(unlist(lapply(latest_b, function(b) read_tbl("SUBMISSION", b)$FILING_DATE)), na.rm = TRUE)))

writeLines(c(format(Sys.time()), if (complete) "COMPLETE" else "INCOMPLETE", verdict),
           file.path(D$state, "last_run.txt"))
unlink(LOCK)
log_msg(sprintf("==== Run finished in %.1f min", as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), RUN_START, units = "mins"))))
```

```r
source("read_insider.R")
trades <- read_insider_trades(from = "2020-01-01", codes = c("P", "S"))   # one row per transaction, with issuer and owner
nd     <- read_insider("nonderiv_trans", from = "2024-01-01")              # any of the 8 tables, with filing info
```
